scoring_note: Gold has 96 canonical source anchors only for grouping-boundary evaluation. Event count 143 vs 96 and legacy Event-ID pairwise=0 are not valid Event extraction metrics.
diagnosis: Task grouping is materially weaker than prior development cases: source-level F1 0.8398, with 35 predicted Tasks vs 32 Gold and 5 Gold sources missing from all predicted Tasks.
The missing Task sources are not Event-extraction misses: every one of the 96 messages produced at least one Event. They were dropped or separated during Event-to-Task integration.

Several Task false positives come from near-identical generic synthetic reply messages reused across different projects. With thread identity completely removed, those messages become semantically indistinguishable after message-level Event extraction.

Work F1 0.5048 is also contaminated by deterministic must-link errors. Two must-link clusters bridge Gold Work boundaries, showing that recurring people/channel/topic overlap is unsafe as a deterministic global handoff rule.

General fix: preserve an opaque Slack thread context key as auxiliary evidence (not a boundary), and restrict deterministic handoff must-links to explicit assignments within the same opaque thread. No case-specific prompt examples were added.
